name: P7: empty () splits onto two lines when the line overflows
note: LOGS-5799 problem 7 (🙈): when the declaration exceeds the 100-col limit, the empty () is the only break point — '(' stays at the end of the line and ');' dangles on its own. The desired (break after '=', keep () together) is reachable ONLY with AlignAfterOpenBracket: Align + a low PenaltyBreakAssignment — Align alone doesn't move it, and that combo regresses 5 agreed styles (P2/P4/P6/long-args/ternary). DontAlign (which fixes P3) breaks after the type, not after '=', so it doesn't help here. No clean fix — muted compromise. Anonymised reconstruction. https://st.yandex-team.ru/LOGS-5799
